Name: Cupcake Stable
Author: nilriMFallout
Description: Hello everyone! This is my first mod making everything all on my own, including the sprites! It took me awhile to do this and to make it look good (I hope), I really hope everyone enjoys this mod! I didn't see anything else like this out there with a cupcake style, I eventually want to redo all the farm buildings like this and update the sprites as I get better at drawing, this is seasonal! So a cupcake for every season! :) Let me know what you guys think of it! and this is open source, feel free to use it but please give me credit and let me know that you are going to use it and for what, and I'd love to see it when your done :) Let me know if you run into any problems with it. This requires alternative textures, you can get the paint bucket and other tools from Robins shop.

Downloads.Description: Turns your stable into a yummy cupcake!
